newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchant's Shekou arm mulls HK listing.
newsitem.headline: China Merchant's Shekou arm mulls HK listing.

text.p: China Merchants Holdings Co Ltd's China Merchants Shekou Industrial Zone has applied to the Chinese authorities for a listing in Hong Kong, a source close to the company said on Monday.
"Preparation works have been carried out but in an initial stage," the source said but declined to give further details.

The company has the right to develop and operate lands in the Shekou industrial zone but the proposed H-share listing would only include its leasing property, petrochemical and port service related businesses, the Hong Kong Economic Journal quoted a representative of the company as saying.
China Merchants Shekou planned to list 300 million shares at a price earnings multiple of not less than 10 times for HK$1.2 billion, the newspaper said.
The company's currently total share capital was HK$1.0 billion and it forecast a net profit of not less than HK$400 million in the first year after listing, it said.

The company planned a B-share listing in 1995 but changed its mind because the issue price for H shares was higher than the Chinese-only B shares, another company official told the newspaper. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
